verdict.rationale: Undermind's enterprise page documents that an organization can request complete removal of its data at any time. That is a first-party deletion capability, but it is request-based and organization-level, with no documented self-serve retention controls. missing for 10: configurable retention periods, self-serve per-item or per-user deletion controls, documentation of the deletion process and timelines, availability outside the enterprise tier, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Request complete removal of your organization's data at any time.
